svg.aria-label: BitaKit architecture: your pages bind actions in BitaKit Core; your plugins and optional BitaKit plugins snap onto Core, which owns services, actions, events, configs, overrides and interceptors; a framework adapter discovers plugin files at build time and generates their registration and types.
